description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Marketing' within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It handles listing and managing marketing campaigns, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and CRUD operations. The class extends an engine controller and interacts with models, views, and URL helpers to generate the marketing management interface in the backend of OpenCart.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing campaigns in the admin interface, including listing, filtering, sorting, and pagination of marketing records.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing campaigns in the admin interface, including listing, filtering, sorting, pagination, CRUD operations, report generation, and autocomplete features.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Entry point for displaying the marketing list page, handling filters, sorting, pagination, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list all marketing records, calls getList, and outputs the response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles the list of marketing campaigns based on filters, sorting, and pagination parameters, preparing data for rendering the view.

methods.name: index

methods.name: form
methods.description: Manages the display of the campaign creation/edit form, loads language, sets titles, handles existing data, and renders the form view.

methods.name: autocomplete
